mapper.insert: insert into learning_interaction (user_id, target_type, target_id, type, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{type}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_interaction where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and type = #{type}
